summary: Independent review of PR #522 at commit 9f419860 found five high-severity blockers: fixture failure, disconnected Kopia repository, incomplete graph-artifacts capture, missing Kopia identity readback, and incomplete disposable-PVC cleanup.
validation: Existing current-run pipeline CI was inspected before report submission.
Review findings are limited to target-only GitOps code and test evidence; no deployment, restore, sync, or secret values were used.
blockers: Static dedicatedPath fixture fails: workspace-context/tests/static.sh and tests/test_workspace_context_llm_proxy_gitops.py do not provide a passing dedicatedPath fixture for the enabled backup/restore path.

Kopia Secret/repository is not connected: workspace-context/templates/backup.yaml and apps/workspace-context.yaml do not connect the rendered Kopia Secret and repository to the backup/restore workload.

Actual graph-artifacts PVC bytes are not bundled: workspace-context/templates/gated.yaml and workspace-context/templates/storage.yaml reference graph artifacts, but the produced bundle does not include the bytes from the actual graph-artifacts PVC.

No Kopia restore/readback identity: workspace-context/templates/backup.yaml, workspace-context/templates/gated.yaml, and llm-proxy/templates/restore.yaml do not prove a Kopia restore followed by readback under the target identity.

Disposable PVC cleanup is incomplete: workspace-context/templates/gated.yaml, workspace-context/templates/storage.yaml, and apps/workspace-context.yaml do not guarantee cleanup of the disposable restore PVC and dependent resources after the check.
next_action: Route to CODE to fix all five PR #522 findings, add deterministic enabled-path fixtures and readback/cleanup assertions, then rerun independent review and current-run CI; do not approve.
independent_lanes: Review PR #522 commit 9f419860 fixture and static guard behavior.
Review Kopia Secret/repository wiring and restore/readback identity.
Review graph-artifacts PVC byte bundling and disposable PVC cleanup.
